node.label: Upper-limb joint contracture
node.definition: A limitation in the passive range of motion of a joint of the upper limb resulting from loss of elasticity in the periarticular tissues owing to structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules or skin.

evidence.snippet: Juvenile amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: Upper-limb joint contracture (frequency HP:0040282) [TAS]
